import heapq

def solve_sokoban(grid_str):
    grid = [line.split() for line in grid_str.strip().split('\n')]
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    
    initial_player = None
    boxes = set()
    goals = set()
    walls = set()
    
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            char = grid[r][c]
            if char == '*':
                initial_player = (r, c)
            elif char == '@':
                boxes.add((r, c))
            elif char == 'X':
                goals.add((r, c))
            elif char == '$':
                boxes.add((r, c))
                goals.add((r, c))
            elif char == '+':
                walls.add((r, c))
            elif char == '%':
                initial_player = (r, c)
                goals.add((r, c))
                
    initial_boxes = frozenset(boxes)
    goals = frozenset(goals)

    def get_reachable(player, current_boxes):
        reachable = set()
        q = collections.deque([player])
        visited = {player}
        while q:
            r, c = q.popleft()
            reachable.add((r, c))
            for dr, dc in [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]:
                nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
                if (nr, nc) not in walls and (nr, nc) not in current_boxes:
                    if (nr, nc) not in visited:
                        visited.add((nr, nc))
                        q.append((nr, nc))
        return frozenset(reachable)

    def get_path(start, end, reachable):
        if start == end: return ""
        q = collections.deque([(start, "")])
        v = {start}
        while q:
            (r, c), p = q.popleft()
            for dr, dc, m in [(-1, 0, 'U'), (1, 0, 'D'), (0, -1, 'L'), (0, 1, 'R')]:
                nr, nc = r+dr, c+dc
                if (nr, nc) == end: return p + m
                if (nr, nc) in reachable and (nr, nc) not in v:
                    v.add((nr, nc))
                    q.append(((nr, nc), p + m))
        return None

    def is_deadlock(box, boxes):
        if box in goals: return False
        r, c = box
        up = (r-1, c) in walls
        down = (r+1, c) in walls
        left = (r, c-1) in walls
        right = (r, c+1) in walls
        if (up and left) or (up and right) or (down and left) or (down and right):
            return True
        return False

    start_reachable = get_reachable(initial_player, initial_boxes)
    start_state = (initial_boxes, min(start_reachable))
    queue = [(0, initial_boxes, start_reachable, "")]
    visited = {start_state: 0}

    while queue:
        dist, current_boxes, reachable, path = heapq.heappop(queue)
        
        if current_boxes == goals:
            return path
            
        for br, bc in current_boxes:
            for dr, dc, move in [(-1, 0, 'U'), (1, 0, 'D'), (0, -1, 'L'), (0, 1, 'R')]:
                pr, pc = br - dr, bc - dc
                nr, nc = br + dr, bc + dc
                
                if (pr, pc) in reachable and (nr, nc) not in walls and (nr, nc) not in current_boxes:
                    new_box_pos = (nr, nc)
                    if is_deadlock(new_box_pos, current_boxes): continue
                    
                    new_boxes = set(current_boxes)
                    new_boxes.remove((br, bc))
                    new_boxes.add(new_box_pos)
                    new_boxes = frozenset(new_boxes)
                    
                    new_reachable = get_reachable((br, bc), new_boxes)
                    new_rep = min(new_reachable)
                    new_state = (new_boxes, new_rep)
                    
                    new_path = path + get_path(min(reachable), (pr, pc), reachable) + move
                    
                    if new_state not in visited or len(new_path) < visited[new_state]:
                        visited[new_state] = len(new_path)
                        # Use boxes-on-goals as a simple heuristic
                        h = sum(1 for b in new_boxes if b not in goals)
                        heapq.heappush(queue, (len(new_path) + h, new_boxes, new_reachable, new_path))
